purpose: Prevent false-complete source claims and enforce canonical interaction/combat authority while convergence work proceeds.

canonical_combat.required: valid target + correct weapon + range + reload => full calculated hit
canonical_combat.enemy_ai_fix: M239 removes broadside/facing alignment as a firing gate. AI may still steer toward a broadside-looking presentation.

regression_guards: Do not add a second pathfinder.
Do not make ships/NPCs/monsters movement blockers.
Do not let HUD become gameplay authority.
Do not infer server readiness from replica contracts.
Do not gate canonical attacks by facing/broadside angle.
Do not alter M213/M214 master camera/world composition without explicit visual-master change.
